test_title: PYST 63: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.

Ramesh licked (A) / honey and (B) / said that (C) / it tasted sweetly. (D)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence is in the use of the word "**sweetly**" in Segment D.
 
• The adverb "**sweetly**" is incorrectly used to describe the taste of the honey.
 
• The correct word should be the adjective "**sweet**" which describes the taste directly.
 
• Since "**tasted**" is a linking verb here, it should be followed by an adjective, not an adverb.
 
• Thus, the sentence should read "***it tasted sweet***" to be grammatically correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"Ramesh licked honey and said that **it tasted sweet.**"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "Ramesh licked"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **B: "honey and"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **C: "said that"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
